g.text: Rendered evidence from captured output
rt. The richest signal for \"is this server healthy, and why not.\"\n- [Check OAuth requirement](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refer
ence/server-diagnostics/check-oauth-requirement.md): Lightweight, no MCP connection: reports whether the server is configured to r
equire an OAuth grant.\n- [List tools](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-tools.md): Returns the server's tools
as a collection page. Each item is the MCP tool definition (`name`, `description`, `inputSchema`, ...).\n- [List prompts](https:/
/docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-prompts.md): Returns the server's prompts as a collection page.\n- [List resources]
(https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-resources.md): Returns the server's resources as a collection page.\n- [Rea
d a resource](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/read-a-resource.md): Reads a single resource by URI and returns its
contents.\n- [List server skills](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-server-skills.md): Returns the Agent Skil
ls a connected server serves over the MCP skills extension (SEP-2640), including skills it advertises that MCPJam declines to load
. Not paginated: the catalog is drained server-side, because duplicate detection spans the whole listing.\n- [Get a server skill](
https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/get-a-server-skill.md): Fetches one skill by URI and verifies it before returning
a byte: the SKILL.md digest against the manifest, the fetched frontmatter against what the listing advertised, and the name again
st the URI. Reaches skills a partial listing never mentioned. When a check fails the response carries a `refusal`…\n- [Read a serv
er skill's supporting file](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/read-a-server-skills-supporting-file.md): Reads one s
upporting file belonging to a skill, checking its byte length and digest against the skill's own manifest. The manifest is the rea
d allowlist and is re-fetched here rather than accepted from the caller, so a request cannot authorize its own read.\n- [Export a
server snapshot](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/export/export-a-server-snapshot.md): Lists tools, resources, and prompts in
one call and returns a single JSON snapshot: handy for diffing a server's surface over time in CI.\n- [Call a tool](https://docs.
mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/call-a-tool.md): Executes a tool on the server and returns the MCP `CallToolResult` plus an add
itive `durationMs` (wall-clock time of `executeTool`). Tool-level failures (`isError: true` in the result) are **successful calls*
*: the server answered; only transport/auth errors use the error envelope.\n- [Render a prompt](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refere
nce/execution/render-a-prompt.md): Renders a prompt with arguments and returns the MCP `GetPromptResult` directly (`description?`,
`messages`).\n- [Render an MCP App widget headlessly](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/render-an-mcp-app-widget-he
adlessly.md): Call an MCP App tool and mount its `ui://` widget in real headless Chromium running the production host bridge, then
report whether it rendered, what it logged, what it was blocked from fetching, and the widget as an accessibility tree with addre
ssable elements.\n- [Create a retained widget session](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/create-a-retained-widget-se
ssion.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user
or API key. A session is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Executes the tool
and retains its App in one local Chromium context.…\n- [Read a retained widget snapshot](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/exe
cution/read-a-retained-widget-snapshot.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments ret
urn 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after its
idle timeout. Returns an accessibility tree and addressable elements without replay…\n- [Act on a retained widget](https://docs.m
cpjam.com/api-reference/execution/act-on-a-retained-widget.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; ho
sted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the original subject, project and server a
nd expires after its idle timeout. Runs one coordinate action with fresh project/server authorization.\n- [Run a retained widget s
tep](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/run-a-retained-widget-step.md): Available only on the local Inspector that cr
eated the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the original subject,
project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Runs one semantic action or assertion, using the same locator vocabul…\n-
[Close a retained widget session](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/close-a-retained-widget-session.md): Available o
nly on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session
is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Disposes the original owner's browser. R
eturns closed=false if no mat…\n- [List a suite's settings history](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/list-a-suite
s-settings-history.md): One entry per committed edit to the suite's settings, newest first: who made it, which STORED fields moved
, the note they left, how many runs were launched against it, and the revision group that ties one request's writes together. Rows
carry no configuration snapshots. Send a `revisionNumber` back…\n- [Attach one environment to a suite (atomic append)](https://do
cs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/attach-one-environment-to-a-suite-atomic-append.md): APPEND one project environment to the
suite's attachments, if it is not already there.\n- [List a server's accounts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accou
nts/list-a-servers-accounts.md): The accounts this server signs in with that you can see: your own personal accounts, or, on a ser
ver shared with the project, its project accounts. Another member's personal account never appears. METADATA ONLY: no account resp
onse carries a token.\n- [Get a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/get-a-server-account.md): On
e account, by id or name. Another member's personal account answers `404`, the same as a missing one. A name two accounts share an
swers `409` with `details.code: \"account_name_ambiguous\"` and both ids in `details.accountIds`.\n- [Upload tokens to a server ac
count](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/upload-tokens-to-a-server-account.md): Creates the account (`201`) or
replaces its token in place (`200`, same id). A well-formed account id never creates one: an unknown id is `404`. Any other refer
ence is a name, and a name no account has creates the account.\n- [Delete a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/
server-accounts/delete-a-server-account.md): Deletes the account and its stored token. The token's issuer is asked to revoke it wh
ere the issuer supports revocation (best effort), which also invalidates any copy of the same token you hold.\n- [Rename a server
account or make it the default](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/rename-a-server-account-or-make-it-the-defau
lt.md): Rename the account, make it the default, or both; a rename applies first. A name another account on the server uses answer
s `409` with `details.code: \"account_name_taken\"`.\n- [Import OAuth tokens](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/oauth/import-o
auth-tokens.md): **Deprecated.** Use `PUT /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/accounts/{account}`. This route uploads to your
default account on the server, creating an unnamed one when the server has none, and is removed 90 days after the accounts API sh
ipped. Every answer carries `Deprecation: true`, a `Sunse…\n- [Create a project](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/cr
eate-a-project.md): Creates a project in the caller's organization and responds `201` with its detail. Requires organization membe
rship and counts against the plan's `maxProjects` limit. Guest callers are denied.\n- [Delete a project and everything scoped to i
